results.title: Multiple-zeta index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An index is a finite sequence $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ of positive integers with $r \ge 0$, so the empty sequence is allowed. It is represented as a natural number $n$ together with a composition of $n$, that is, a sequence of positive integers with sum $n$.

results.title: Entries of an index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The entries of an index $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ form the list $[k_1, \ldots, k_r]$ of its terms, in order.

results.title: Weight of an index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The weight of an index $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ is the sum $k_1 + \cdots + k_r$ of its entries.

results.title: Depth of an index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The depth of an index $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ is its number of entries $r$.

results.title: Height of an index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The height of an index $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ is the number of positions $i$ with $1 \le i \le r$ and $k_i \ge 2$.

results.title: Admissible index
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An index $(k_1, \ldots, k_r)$ is admissible when it is nonempty ($r \ge 1$) and its first entry satisfies $k_1 \ge 2$.

results.title: Admissible list
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A list $[k_1, \ldots, k_r]$ of natural numbers is admissible when it is nonempty ($r \ge 1$), $k_1 \ge 2$, and $k_i > 0$ for every $i$ with $2 \le i \le r$.

results.title: Admissibility of an index via its entries

results.summary: An index is admissible if and only if the list of its entries is an admissible list.

results.title: Hoffman block

results.title: Overpartitions into odd parts
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n)$ is the number of overpartitions of $n$ all of whose parts are odd.

results.title: Overpartitions of zero into odd parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: The number $\mathrm{po}(0)$ of overpartitions of $0$ into odd parts equals $1$: the empty overpartition is the only one.

results.title: Pentagonal recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(j)$ be the number of overpartitions of $j$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_k (-1)^k \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(3k+1)/2)$ over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1)/2 \le n$ equals $(-1)^{\lceil m/2 \rceil}$ if $n = m(3m+1)/2$ for some integer $m$, and $0$ otherwise.

results.title: Triangular recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Write $\mathrm{po}(m)$ for the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\sum_{k \ge 0,\ k(k+1)/2 \le n} (-1)^{\lceil k/2 \rceil} \, \mathrm{po}(n - k(k+1)/2)$ equals $1$ if $n = m(m+1)/2$ for some natural number $m$, and equals $0$ otherwise.

results.title: Square recurrence for overpartitions into odd parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Write $\mathrm{po}(m)$ for the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts. For every natural number $n$, the sum $\mathrm{po}(n) + 2 \sum_{k \ge 1,\ 2k^2 \le n} (-1)^k \, \mathrm{po}(n - 2k^2)$ equals $1$ if $n = 0$, equals $2$ if $n = m^2$ for some integer $m \ge 1$, and equals $0$ otherwise.

results.title: Overpartitions into odd parts from partitions and pentagonal numbers
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\mathrm{po}(m)$ be the number of overpartitions of $m$ into odd parts and $p(m)$ the number of partitions of $m$. For every natural number $n$, $\mathrm{po}(n) = \sum_k (-1)^{\lceil k/2 \rceil} p(n - k(3k+1)/2)$, the sum running over the integers $k$ with $k(3k+1)/2 \le n$.

results.title: Merca's triangular recurrence for partitions with distinct even parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\operatorname{ped}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ in which no even part is repeated. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_{j \ge 0} (-1)^{\lceil j/2 \rceil} \operatorname{ped}(n - j(j+1)/2)$ over the $j$ with $j(j+1)/2 \le n$ equals $1$ if $n = k(k+1)$ for some integer $k \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.

results.title: Merca's square recurrence for partitions with distinct even parts
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $\operatorname{ped}(m)$ be the number of partitions of $m$ in which no even part is repeated. For every $n \ge 0$, the sum $\sum_j (-1)^j \operatorname{ped}(n - 2j^2)$ over the integers $j$ with $2j^2 \le n$ equals $1$ if $n = k(k+1)/2$ for some integer $k \ge 0$, and $0$ otherwise.

results.title: Feasible knapsack instances

results.title: Extension of an edge function to a current

results.title: Current sum with prescribed sources
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The current sum `Z(∂ = A) = ∑_{∂n = A} w(n)` over currents on the edges of `G`.

results.title: Term of the exponential expansion of an edge weight
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The `k`-th term `(βJ_e σ_e)^k / k!` of the expansion of `exp(βJ_e σ_e)`.

results.title: Boltzmann weight with couplings
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The Boltzmann weight `exp(β ∑_e J_e σ_e)` with couplings `J`.

results.title: Partition function with couplings
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Correlation function with couplings

Ginibre (1970); H. Duminil-Copin, "Random currents expansion of the Ising model", lecture notes (2016), arXiv:1607.06933.

results.title: Odd-current path as a backbone path
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A path with odd current on every edge as a backbone path.

results.title: Least backbone path between two vertices
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The least backbone path from `x` to `y`, if any.

results.title: Weight of currents with a given selected backbone
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: `Z_ω`: the total weight of currents with sources `{x, y}` whose selected backbone is `ω`.

results.title: Backbone weight $\rho(\omega)$
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The backbone weight `ρ(ω) = Z_ω/Z(∂ = ∅)`.

results.title: Unordered pair inside a set

results.title: Restriction of a current to a set
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The restriction `n|_S` of a current to the edges inside `S`, zero elsewhere.

results.title: Subsets of a sigma type as families of fibre subsets

results.title: Edge copies of a current

results.title: Profile of a set of edge copies

results.title: Connectivity in a multigraph edge set

results.title: Cluster of a vertex in a multigraph edge set

Duminil-Copin, "Random currents expansion of the Ising model", lecture notes (2016), arXiv:1607.06933.
